title: Inference Incident Index and Remediation Playbook
creator: Priya Shah
description: Build a single searchable Incident Index and Remediation Playbook that centralizes inference error taxonomy (timeouts, overload/queue saturation, model errors, HTTP/gRPC status mappings, OOMs, and client-side throttling) and wires it to tracing hooks, metric/log pipelines, and a new dashboard surface. The index should: 1) normalize error events across services (frontend API, router, serving runtime, model infra), 2) enrich spans with model_variant/model_id, batch_size, kv_cache_hit, and queue_depth, 3) provide deterministic mapping from observability signals to a canonical root-cause tag for downstream dashboards and SLOs, and 4) surface runbook steps and quick links (Playbook) for on-call. This ticket covers design, instrumentation changes, pipeline transforms, dashboard panels, and rollout plan for canary customers.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical taxonomy document stored in Confluence: mapping of symptom -> source -> remediation
Trace-enricher deployed in staging that adds fields: model_id, model_variant, batch_size, kv_cache_hit, queue_size, route_id
Prometheus metrics updated for queue_depth and model_reject_rate with labels: route_id, model_variant
Loki log parser rule for inference_rejects and client_timeouts with structured fields
Dashboard (Grafana) with: caller-latency-percentiles by route, model-reject-rate heatmap, queue_depth over time, gRPC/HTTP status breakdown, and SLO-aligned alert panels
Runbook pages linked from dashboard panels with actionable remediation steps and rollback links
Adaptive sampling rule that increases trace retention for error and high-latency spans enabled and validated
End-to-end tests that simulate timeout, overload and model-oom to validate alerts and playbook links
tasks: Design canonical taxonomy and mapping table (symptom -> probable root cause)
Implement trace-enricher sidecar to attach inference metadata to spans
Update gRPC/HTTP middleware to emit canonical error tags and map status codes
Add Prometheus exporters for queue_depth, batch_size_histogram, model_reject_rate
Add Loki ingestion rules for structured inference logs and index key fields
Create Grafana panels and templated filters (by route/model/variant/customer tier)
Author runbook steps and validation checklists for each top-level taxonomy bucket
Canary rollout plan and regression testing against staging traffic profile
Postmortem / incident drill run with SREs and on-call rotation to validate playbooks
comments: 2026-02-20 Priya Shah: Drafted ticket and initial taxonomy. Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Inference+Incident+Index. Main goal is to reduce mean time to resolution by making root-cause deterministic across layers.

2026-02-24 Alex Kim: Proposal to add kv_cache_hit and batch_size to spans accepted — these fields are critical for disambiguating model-side latency vs queuing. Created RFC PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/76

2026-03-01 Elena Martinez (SRE): Noted tradeoff: enriching every span increases storage and index cost. Suggested adaptive sampling on non-error low-latency traces and full retention for errors and top-10% latency. Will prototype sampler change in staging.

2026-03-03 Design review (Mateo Rodriguez): Dashboard wireframes uploaded to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/obs-dashboard/Infernce-Index-Viewport. Recommended a top-level 'Incident Index' search bar for quick lookups by request_id and model_id.

2026-03-05 Engineering update (Alex Kim): PoC trace-enricher implemented as a small Go service. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/trace-enricher/pull/12. It reads spans, enriches with model metadata from runtime headers, and forwards to Tempo/Loki. Initial perf numbers look acceptable (2% p50 overhead on critical path).

2026-03-08 QA note (Sofia Nguyen): Created synthetic test harness that can replay timeout/overload/model-oom scenarios. Found a false positive mapping where transient backend 502s were being classified as model errors — added additional rule for 'backend-502-without-model-reject' to avoid noisy alerts.

2026-03-11 Product review (Priya Shah): Confirmed dashboards tie to SLOs; added requirement to surface 'blame likelihood' score (0-100) per incident computed from combined signals (queue_depth, batch_size anomaly, kv_cache_miss, model_reject_rate).
